name: Veltrio
subtitle: Every source, one native player.
description: Official AltStore / SideStore source for Veltrio — free, ad-free, open-source media player for iPhone and iPad.

apps.name: Veltrio
apps.subtitle: Stremio addons, debrid, Plex/Jellyfin/Emby & Live IPTV
apps.localizedDescription: Free, ad-free, open-source native media player powered by libmpv. Connect your Stremio addons, Real-Debrid / AllDebrid / TorBox / Premiumize, Plex / Jellyfin / Emby servers, and M3U / Xtream IPTV playlists in one app.

versions.localizedDescription: Initial public iOS & iPadOS IPA release with Stremio account import, debrid PIN login, Plex/Jellyfin/Emby, Live IPTV + EPG, and native iOS 27 Liquid Glass navigation.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Veltrio discovers Chromecasts, local media servers, and Veltrio TVs on your local network.
